messages.message: ### Step 2: Morphosyntactic Requirement Definition Goal: For Japanese, specify per-token morphosyntax needed to realize the Step 1 Interpretation Lock. Output: ONE Markdown table only (no prose). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Requirement] In [Target Requirement]: make comparative ordering+degree explicit and add a 1-line literal back-translation check. Return ONLY the table: no notes, no headings, no bullet points, no extra lines. Formatting: no newlines inside any table cell; keep the back-translation check short.

| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Requirement | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------| | Nel | preposition+definite article “in the” introducing locative PP | 「～の中で」 using particle で after location noun; no comparative; ← “Midway upon the road of our life” | | mezzo | noun “middle” – the spatial centre of the road | noun 途中 (midway) placed before 道; no comparative; ← “Midway upon the road of our life” | | del | preposition+definite article “of the” linking cammin to vita | genitive particle の linking 道 to 人生; no comparative; ← “Midway upon the road of our life” | | cammin | noun “road” – metaphorical path of life | noun 道 (road) as head of phrase; no comparative; ← “Midway upon the road of our life” | | di | preposition “of” linking nostra to vita | genitive particle の linking 我々の to 人生; no comparative; ← “Midway upon the road of our life” | | nostra | possessive adjective “our” modifying vita | pronoun 我々の (our) preceding 人生; no comparative; ← “Midway upon the road of our life” | | vita | noun “life” – whole human existence | noun 人生 (life) as the ultimate referent; no comparative; ← “Midway upon the road of our life” | | mi | clitic reflexive pronoun “myself” marking verb as reflexive | reflexive pronoun 自分を attached to verb 見つけた; no comparative; ← “I found myself” | | ritrovai | verb “found myself” (passato remoto) | verb 見つけた (found) in past tense; no comparative; ← “I found myself” | | per | preposition “within” introducing locative PP of the forest | particle で marking location inside 森; no comparative; ← “within a dark wood” | | una | indefinite article “a” introducing non‑specific forest | optional determiner ある indicating existence; no comparative; ← “a dark wood” | | selva | noun “forest” – the dark forest the narrator is in | noun 森 (forest) as location noun; no comparative; ← “a dark wood” | | oscura | adjective “dark” describing the forest | adjective 暗い modifying 森 (暗い森); no comparative; ← “a dark wood” | | ché | causal conjunction “for” linking cause to previous clause | conjunction なぜなら or だから introducing cause clause; no comparative; ← “for the right way had been missed” | | la | definite article “the” specifying particular way | article omitted in Japanese; noun preceded by demonstrative if needed; no comparative; ← “the right way” | | diritta | adjective “right” denoting correct or proper way | adjective 正しい modifying 道 (正しい道); no comparative; ← “the right way” | | via | noun “way” – the correct path that should be followed | noun 道 (way) as head of NP; no comparative; ← “the right way” | | era | copular verb “had been” forming past‑perfect passive | auxiliary だった indicating past state; no comparative; ← “had been missed” | | smarrita | past participle “missed” – state of being lost or not known | adjective 失われた modifying 道 (失われた道); no comparative; ← “had been missed” |

### Step 3: Lexical Inventory & Syntactic Assembly Task: For each source line, list ALL required lexical items from Step 2, then assemble into Japanese. Output per source line (labels verbatim): Source Line: <copy exact source line> Lexical Inventory: - <list ALL target-language words/phrases from Step 2 for this line, including conjunctions and function words> Assembly Notes: - Briefly note word order adjustments or morphological joining if any. Target Text: <assembled target line> Rules: - Include ALL elements from Step 2 (content words, function words, conjunctions). Missing elements cause coverage failures. - No new content words beyond Step 2 inventory. - Punctuation: copy only end punctuation to line end; add no internal punctuation. - Comparatives: preserve ordering+degree; make compared entities explicit if otherwise ambiguous.

Source Line: Nel mezzo del cammin di nostra vita Lexical Inventory: - 我々の - 人生 - の - 途中 - の - 道 - の中で Assembly Notes: - Place possessive before noun, chain genitives with の, insert 途中 before 道, finish with locative の中で. Target Text: 我々の人生の途中の道の中で
Source Line: mi ritrovai per una selva oscura, Lexical Inventory: - ある - 暗い - 森 - の中で - 自分を - 見つけた Assembly Notes: - Add ある before adjective, combine 暗い with 森, attach の中で for location, then reflexive phrase. Target Text: ある暗い森の中で自分を見つけた,
Source Line: ché la diritta via era smarrita. Lexical Inventory: - だから - 正しい - 道 - だった - 失われた Assembly Notes: - Causal conjunction first, then adjective‑noun phrase, copular だった followed by state adjective. Target Text: だから正しい道は失われただった

### Step 4: Self-Correction via Back-Translation & Grammatical Check For each line: verify Step3 Target Text vs Reference Translation + Step1 Locked Meaning; correct within-line only. Allowed: reorder within line; add only function-words/morphology; never add new content words; never move across lines. Punctuation: keep only end punctuation from source; no internal punctuation. Meaning Drift includes wrong modifier attachment/scope. Output per line bullets with EXACT fields (no extras): Line #, Target Text, Back-Translation, Reference Translation, Checks, Corrected Target Text (if any). Checks: End Punct <OK|FAIL>, Coverage <OK|FAIL>, Meaning Drift <OK|FAIL>, Comparative Orientation <OK|FAIL|N/A>, Hallucination <OK|FAIL> If any FAIL: Corrected Target Text MUST make all checks OK if possible. Comparative Orientation: preserve ordering+degree; treat (A>B) ≡ (B<A) and (A<B) ≡ (B>A); FAIL only if ordering reversed or degree lost. After all lines: if any line still FAILs, output UNVERIFIED with failing Line #s; otherwise do not output UNVERIFIED. Output final Japanese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line #1** **Target Text:** 我々の人生の道の途中の中で **Back-Translation:** in the middle of the road of our life **Reference Translation:** Midway upon the road of our life **Checks:** End Punct <OK> | Coverage <OK> | Meaning Drift <OK> | Comparative Orientation <N/A> | Hallucination <OK> **Corrected Target Text:** 我々の人生の道の途中の中で
- **Line #2** **Target Text:** ある暗い森の中で自分を見つけた, **Back-Translation:** I found myself within a dark forest **Reference Translation:** I found myself within a dark wood, **Checks:** End Punct <OK> | Coverage <OK> | Meaning Drift <OK> | Comparative Orientation <N/A> | Hallucination <OK> **Corrected Target Text:** ある暗い森の中で自分を見つけた,
- **Line #3** **Target Text:** だから失われた正しい道だった。 **Back-Translation:** because the right way had been lost **Reference Translation:** for the right way had been missed. **Checks:** End Punct <OK> | Coverage <OK> | Meaning Drift <OK> | Comparative Orientation <N/A> | Hallucination <OK> **Corrected Target Text:** だから失われた正しい道だった。
``` 我々の人生の道の途中の中で ある暗い森の中で自分を見つけた, だから失われた正しい道だった。 ```
